Mode.Army.Name: Unit Deployment
Mode.Army.Action.select: Select unit (Shift adds / Ctrl removes); the status bar shows unit and trap info
Mode.Army.Action.copy: Copy unit (copies every unit in a multi-selection)
Mode.Army.Action.paste: Paste unit (a multi-copy keeps its layout, current hex = top-left)
Mode.Army.Action.remove: Delete unit (deletes every unit in a multi-selection)
Mode.Army.Action.set_legion: Set unit faction from hex ownership
Mode.Army.Action.legion_strength: Set faction strength from config (choose ownership and strength level)
Mode.Army.Action.generate_by_probability: Generate units by probability (choose ownership, -1 = all factions)
Mode.Army.Action.auto_general: Auto-assign generals (choose ownership and number of generals)
Mode.Army.Action.batch_plan_by_legion: Batch-set unit plan (choose ownership and plan)
Mode.Army.Action.remove_by_belong: Delete all units of an ownership (enter the ownership value)
Mode.Army.Action.trap_copy: Copy trap (copies the unit when the hex has no trap)
Mode.Army.Action.trap_paste: Paste trap (pastes a unit when no trap has been copied)
Mode.Army.Action.trap_remove: Delete trap (deletes the unit when the hex has no trap)
Mode.Army.Action.trap_generate: Batch-generate traps by ownership and probability (skips buildings, sea optional)
Mode.Army.Action.trap_generate_by_provin: Generate one trap per province by probability
Mode.Army.Action.trap_find: Find traps by level (repeat with the same level to jump to the next one)
Mode.Army.Action.toggle_brush: Toggle unit eraser brush (right-drag to delete units)

Mode.Army.Dialog.ClearGeneralsMessage:
Remove the generals already assigned to units?

Yes: remove them; units that had a general also get a new one
No: keep existing generals and skip those units
Mode.Army.Dialog.AdaptGeneralsMessage:
Match generals to units?

Yes: each general goes to a unit of their specialty (infantry general -> infantry unit)
No: assign as many generals as possible, picking a random unit when no specialty matches
